question: Can Infrastructure Compounder remove its three-player greedy dominance and approach neutral share across all supported counts when trained against the exact frozen Trust, Capacity, and AGI artifacts from the failed full-ecology holdout?

selectionRule.ordering: Minimize the largest absolute miss from 1/player-count, then mean miss, then ordinary fitness. Every candidate receives common seeds within its generation and equal exposure to all six circular opponent windows.
selectionRule.nomination: Nominate only if the candidate improves the authored baseline's largest neutral-share miss, retains mean score of at least 16 at every supported count, keeps the authored Generator and two-Facility transition rules, and retains Build as a material Core Action rather than becoming a generic research profile.
selectionRule.holdoutIdentity: A fresh holdout must average at least two Build selections per Infrastructure appearance, retain mean Mandate of at least 16, and remove the registered three-player greedy diagnostic dominance.
selectionRule.pathGate: The package must also raise five-player winning-path entropy to at least 0.60. Training may not claim this from focal-profile win share alone.
selectionRule.rejection: If no candidate passes the training score and identity floors, reject the intervention without another adaptive run.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: This study changes only Infrastructure policy weights. Starting resources, factions, Core Action rules, Dossier mechanics, scoring, and physical components remain canonical.

knownLimits: The failed AGI proposal is a frozen experimental component, not a promoted canonical profile.
Deterministic policies are strategy probes, not human play.
Simulation cannot establish fun, negotiation quality, teachability, duration, or physical handling.
